plan: Queue support as primary. It is Willy's best role at 51.1% over 352 games (overall is 50.5%). Set jungle as secondary, not the other way around.
Comfort-hero rule for the climb: Skylar. Compared with the average player on the same hero, Willy wins about 3.7 more games per 100 on it.
Willy's champion pool is 13+ heroes wide and the top three are only 44% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
The math: Willy is at 423 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 903 — Platinum-level rating has been touched once already; this is a consistency problem, not a ceiling problem.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why

insights.title: Willy is a closer, not a marathoner
insights.finding: Games under 28 minutes: 56%. Past 32: 36%. Press early leads and call objectives; do not let games drift.
insights.receipt: wins 9 of 16 short games vs 5 of 14 long ones, recent sample

insights.title: Gadget is the long-term relationship
insights.finding: 228 games on Gadget at 50.1% — the field averages 50.7%. The comfort is real; the edge is roughly neutral.

insights.title: Mr_Meat31 brings out Willy's best
insights.finding: Willy's record alongside Mr_Meat31 is 54% over 354 ranked games — the strongest pairing in the stack. When only two of the squad queue, make it this pair.

insights.title: For the group chat
insights.finding: 1 pentakill in real 5v5s and a longest spree of 23 (plus 1 more in ARAM and brawls — the group chat can rule on whether those count). Willy has receipts.
